name: hcapp_getMyPhotoAssetIds
description: The camera-roll asset ids of photos the CALLER has already uploaded, optionally narrowed to one kennel or one run. Lets the camera-roll sweep say '14 eligible, 6 already added' and stop offering a photo that is already on the run, with one call for a whole kennel. Only rows with DeletedAt NULL and a non-empty AssetId. Auth: HC6.ValidateAppAuth (spNumber 102, @param NULL); the rows are the caller's own. Runtime errors are logged to HC.ErrorLog and re-thrown.

rowsets.name: ErrorEnvelope
rowsets.description: On auth failure only (ValidateAppAuth): { success=0, errorCode, errorType }, paired with StandardErrorResult at index 1. Mutually exclusive with MyPhotoAssetIds.
Paired with ErrorEnvelope on auth failure. Not present on success.

rowsets.name: MyPhotoAssetIds
rowsets.description: One row per uploaded photo of the caller's that carries a camera-roll asset id. Never includes anybody else's photos: an asset id is a handle into a private photo library.

columns.name: eventId
columns.description: The run the photo belongs to.

columns.name: assetId
columns.description: The camera-roll identifier the photo was uploaded from.

sideEffects: INSERT HC.ErrorLog from the CATCH block (lines 73-75, after ROLLBACK)

codeSmells.detail: @deviceId and @accessToken (lines 2-3) have no SQL default. A client that omits either gets 'expects parameter' — an unlogged empty 500 before the SP runs — instead of ValidateAppAuth's logged auth error.
The SP sets SET NOCOUNT ON only. Harmless for a read with no transaction, but inconsistent with the HC6 SP standard, which requires both.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
